title: OptimizationRefusal
description: Wire refusal envelope for the content-less compatibility matrix. Compatible with the generic error envelope (same success/message/error/error_code members) but closed: `error_code` is one of the wire refusal codes, `message` is the fixed text for that code, and nothing of the request is echoed. `backend_upgrade_required` is a client-local refusal (raised by a content-less client when the Backend does not advertise `content_less_v1`) and never appears on the wire.

error.description: Fixed broad error name for every refusal in this envelope.

error_code.description: The wire subset of OptimizationRefusalCode in session_capabilities_schema.json.

enum: Session was created with the legacy shape; start a new session.
message.description: Fixed text per code: client_upgrade_required -> the first, session_shape_legacy -> the second.

message.const: Session was created with the legacy shape; start a new session.
